title: Grateful Dead Live at Compton Terrace Amphitheatre on 1983-03-25
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 09/2015
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell XLII (S1) and Hitachi ME-Metal (S2). Set up FOB, recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Excellent in‑your‑face Nakamichi cassette capture of a solid early‑80s run of shows.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the NAK‑300 source as sounding “excellent” and “in your face,” indicating a high‑quality audience tape with warm, punchy fidelity. While no specific songs or musical moments are called out, the comment about a “nice run of shows” suggests the performances were enjoyable across venues like Compton, Aladdin, Irving and Warfield.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 5‑star review; recording quality is described as excellent while the show is generally regarded positively but without detailed musical analysis.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, punchy "in your face" sound typical of high‑end Nakamichi cassette recordings; praised as the best Dead source by the reviewer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer mentions a nice run of shows across several venues but provides no specific comments on set pacing or individual songs.
